rationale: The short thesis remains intact — SRRK gapped up nearly 2% and has faded all day, with price below both session VWAP ($54.09) and the 9-EMA ($53.49), consolidating near the lows on drying volume with no bounce attempt and no new headlines. The tape is mildly risk-off (SPY -0.28%, VIXY +1.16%), supporting continued downside drift toward the $52.30 target, while invalidation at $53.75 still leaves ~1% of headroom. A flip to long would be counter-trend against the VWAP and would cost ~45bps in spread/commissions with no stronger supporting evidence, so holding is the best use of the current edge.
